summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked, session search budget largely exhausted). Fifty source leads recorded for India-Nepal economic relations, reused from the shared lead register and upstream agents 16A/16B/17A/17C/17D/21B/22A/22B: Nepal customs trade books and portal, NTIP/TEPC treaty texts (Treaty of Trade, Treaty of Transit 1999 and compilation), unauthorised-trade agreement, MEA/MoFA joint statements, PIB releases on IGC and rail connectivity, NOC import pages and IOC release, NEA annual reports, the 2014 Power Trade Agreement text, Indian MoP/CEA/CERC cross-border electricity instruments, NRB CME reports and peg analysis, RBI exchange-control rules, World Bank NIRTTP appraisal and LPI 2023, ICRIER transit study, WTO TPR and NITDB. Q1 (India share of goods trade, fuel imports and transit) is split into partner share, route share, petroleum supplier/route share, electricity trade and currency exposure - all pending. Q2 (governing agreements and last revision) is set up as an eleven-row inventory - all statuses and revision dates pending primary texts. Q3 (border-administration costs and delays) is pending; no Nepal time-release study was located. Qualitative domestic policy constraints (peg, power-market approvals, treaty-bounded trade policy) are recorded as labelled assumptions. No numbers are recorded.

findings.claim: Q1a: Share of Nepal's merchandise imports and exports accounted for by India (partner basis), Nepal FY2022/23 onward.
findings.note: Customs partner tables (04A-L01..L03), NRB CME trade-by-country table (04A-L33, L34) as conflict check, UN Comtrade India-reported mirror (04A-L46). Leads: 04A-L01, 04A-L02, 04A-L03, 04A-L04, 04A-L33, 04A-L34, 04A-L46

findings.claim: Q1b: Share of Nepal's total goods trade (including third-country trade) that physically crosses the India border, i.e. transits India, Nepal FY2022/23 onward.
findings.note: Requires customs-office-level totals (southern offices vs northern offices vs airport) from customs trade books and NITDB cargo statistics; partner share understates India-route dependence because third-country imports transit Indian ports. Leads: 04A-L01, 04A-L03, 04A-L43, 04A-L39

findings.claim: Q1c: Share of petroleum-product imports sourced from India (supplier) and share entering via India (route), by product, Nepal FY.
findings.note: NOC import records (04A-L19, L20) and customs HS 27 by partner (04A-L01); supplier concentration primarily owned by 22A/21D (X07).

findings.claim: Q1d: Electricity traded with India (exports and imports) by market segment, Nepal FY.
findings.note: NEA annual reports energy-balance tables (04A-L23); approved capacity (CEA list, 04A-L25) must be kept separate from realised flows. Primary owner 22B/17C; 04A consumes.

findings.claim: Q1e: Currency exposure - share of Nepal's external payments settled in INR and NRB INR purchases against convertible currency, Nepal FY.
findings.note: NRB CME reports (04A-L33, L34); RBI exchange-control rules for context (04A-L36, L37).

findings.claim: Q2: Instruments governing Nepal-India trade, transit and power trade are inventoried in specific.agreement_inventory (Treaty of Trade; Treaty of Transit with protocol and letters of exchange; agreement on control of unauthorised trade; rail-services agreement; 2014 Power Trade Agreement; long-term power trade agreement reported January 2024; Indian cross-border electricity guidelines/procedure/regulations; petroleum supply arrangement IOC-NOC; RBI exchange-control rules). Last-revision dates are pending retrieval of primary texts.
findings.note: Revision chronology from the texts themselves and joint statements/IGC releases (04A-L05..L16, L24..L30); news items (L17, L29, L31, L32, L48) only locate documents.

findings.claim: Q3: Documented border-administration time and cost for Nepal-India crossings (import and export clearance time at principal ICPs/customs offices; transit time from Kolkata/Haldia/Visakhapatnam; documentary requirements) are pending.
findings.period: latest available study year (to be recorded)
findings.note: World Bank NIRTTP appraisal baselines (04A-L39), LPI 2023 (L40), ICRIER transit study (L41), WTO TPR (L42), NITDB (L43); Nepal customs time-release study not located (data gap). Route-cost comparison primarily owned by 21B (X08).

findings.claim: Method: India trade share is computed on Nepal customs basis (imports CIF, exports FOB, Nepal FY mid-July to mid-July); India-reported mirror values (Indian FY April-March or calendar year) are kept as a separate series and differences documented per 00B conflict register, never netted or silently replaced.

Domestic policy constraint (qualitative, conditional on lead retrieval): because the NPR is pegged to the INR (NRB analysis, 04A-L38), Indian monetary conditions and INR/USD movements transmit into Nepal's price level and external accounts, which constrains the independent use of the exchange rate and interest rates in Nepal's macro policy. Magnitude pending.

Domestic policy constraint (qualitative): Nepal's electricity-export strategy and hydropower investment planning depend on Indian approval and market-access rules (MoP guidelines, CEA designated-authority procedure, CERC regulations; 04A-L25..L28); planned export revenues should be modelled as conditional on approvals, not as baseline.

Domestic policy constraint (qualitative): trade-policy instruments available to Nepal (tariff changes, quantitative measures, rules of origin) are bounded by the Treaty of Trade and Treaty of Transit terms and their review process reported for September 2026 (04A-L05..L07, L17); content and binding clauses pending retrieval of texts.
This register describes documented dependencies and the policy constraints they imply; it does not state or represent the position of the Government of Nepal or the Government of India.

data_gaps: Nepal customs trade books FY2023/24 and FY2024/25 (document-level URLs not located); office-level trade by customs point for route share.
Nepal customs time-release study or equivalent border clearance-time measurement for principal India-border ICPs.
NOC supply agreement text with IOC and product-level import records by entry point.
Text of the January 2024 long-term power trade agreement and signed JSC/JWG minutes (2025-2026).
IGSC/IGC minutes for the September 2026 treaty review and Indian primary notifications behind the reported 2026 import-side measures.
Letters of exchange amending the Treaty of Transit after 1999 (consolidated list).
Informal/unrecorded Nepal-India border trade estimates (no lead).

assumptions.text: India trade share is computed on Nepal customs basis (Nepal FY); mirror data are a separate series for conflict checks.
Agreement status classes follow 17B-A1; news items locate documents but never set status.
Approved (CEA) export capacity and contracted power volumes are not realised exports; only NEA energy-balance records count as realised.
Policy-constraint statements are qualitative translations of documented arrangements and do not represent any government's position.

challenges.text: EXP-03 (goods trade concentration with India) should record partner share and route share as separate measures: partner share understates dependence because third-country trade transits Indian ports and border offices.
Border-cost evidence overlaps X08; please confirm that 21B owns port-to-border transit time/cost and 04A owns border-crossing clearance/dwell time, to avoid double counting in S02/S10.
Source catalog lacks ids for India's Ministry of Power, CERC, PIB and IOC; 04A leads use cea_india/mea_india as nearest ids or null. Add ids before r2.

17A lists the Treaty of Trade revision year and the June 2023 transit protocol as provisional; 04A agreement_inventory will adopt them only after the primary texts (04A-L05..L08, L13, L16) are retrieved.

uncertainty: Very high for r1: no document was downloaded, so every share, date and cost is pending. The agreement inventory may omit instruments signed in 2025-2026 (only news locators were available for the September 2026 treaty review, 2026 import-side measures, October 2025 transmission agreements and September 2026 MoP approval). Border-cost evidence is sparse and methodologically heterogeneous. Qualitative policy constraints are hypotheses to be confirmed against texts.

india_trade_share.period_basis: Nepal FY (mid-July to mid-July); partner mirror data calendar or Indian FY, kept separate
india_trade_share.method: Four distinct shares, not to be conflated: (a) partner share of imports and exports (customs partner tables); (b) route share - trade crossing India border offices incl. third-country transit (customs office-level tables, NITDB); (c) petroleum supplier and route share by product (NOC, customs HS 27); (d) electricity trade by segment (NEA). Conflict checks: NRB CME trade table and UN Comtrade India-reported mirror.

components.data_required: Imports and exports by partner (India, total), Nepal FY2022/23-FY2025/26
Trade by customs office (southern border offices, northern offices, TIA airport), third-country cargo through Indian ports
Petroleum imports by product, supplier and entry point (pipeline vs road)
Exports/imports to India by bilateral, exchange and trilateral segment; realised price (22B)
INR share of payments; NRB INR purchase/USD sales; exchange-control limits

known_methodological_issues: Nepal FY vs Indian FY/calendar year
whether electricity exports are included in customs merchandise totals varies by year - verify
partner share (origin) differs from route share (transit)

agreement_inventory.method: One row per instrument; status class per 17B-A1 (OPERATIONAL, IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE, AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED, PROPOSED, LAPSED_OR_STALLED) assigned only from retrieved primary text; last-revision date recorded from the text, joint statement or IGC minutes. Coordinates with 17A policy_watchlist and 17D agreement_status_table (row 'India-Nepal Treaty of Trade and Treaty of Transit').

border_cost_evidence.method: Collect documented clearance/dwell times and costs per crossing and direction from (1) World Bank NIRTTP appraisal baselines, (2) Nepal customs/time-release studies (not yet located), (3) NITDB ICD/ICP dwell statistics, (4) ICRIER transit study, (5) LPI 2023 as country-level context only; record study year and method; costs in USD_current or NPR_current per consignment/TEU with year; no pooling across methods.
